title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Xavier Worthy logs six receptions in Week 9 win
items.desc: Xavier Worthy caught all six of his targets for 48 yards in a 35-12 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Worthy led the Chiefs pass catchers in receptions Sunday, with Travis Kelce leading in yardage and Rashee Rice leading in targets. He did suffer a hamstring injury that saw him quickly ruled out by the team. Fantasy managers will want to monitor his status ahead of a Week 10 matchup with the Falcons.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jake Ferguson catches TD, leaves with knee injury in Week 9
items.desc: Jake Ferguson caught both of his targets for 21 yards and a touchdown in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
items.impact: Ferguson hauled in a 10-yard touchdown from Dak Prescott in the second quarter but later left with a knee injury during the third quarter. His status for Week 10's matchup vs. the 49ers is now in question. Brevyn Spann-Ford would be in line for a larger role if Ferguson can't suit up.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Brevyn Spann-Ford catches two passes in Week 9
items.desc: Brevyn Spann-Ford caught two of his three passes for 20 yards in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
items.impact: Spann-Ford was quiet despite Jake Ferguson leaving with a knee injury during the win. The veteran tight end now has 15 catches for 130 yards through nine games. He would presumably be in line for a larger role in Week 10 vs. the 49ers if Ferguson can't suit up.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Rashee Rice hauls in five passes in Week 9
items.desc: Rashee Rice caught 5-of-7 targets for 49 yards in a 35-12 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Rice was limited during the week ahead of this game with knee and hamstring injures, but played well and did the most of his opportunities. Rice and the Chiefs will take on the Falcons in Week 10.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Ryan Flournoy goes for 53 yards in Week 9
items.desc: Ryan Flournoy caught two of his three targets for 53 yards in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
items.impact: Flournoy was quiet despite the Cowboys playing without George Pickens (hamstring) in the contest. The veteran wideout has been a solid WR3 for Dallas this season, catching 32 passes for 395 yards and two touchdowns in nine games. He will be on the flex radar against the 49ers in Week 10 if Pickens is unable to suit up.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Kenneth Walker III finds the end zone three times in Week 9 win
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III rushed for 102 yards and one touchdown on 18 carries in a 35-12 win over the Jets. He caught all four of his targets for 41 yards and two touchdowns
items.impact: Walker bounced back after struggling against Denver and Seattle over the last two weeks. Walker eclipsed 100 rushing yards for the fifth time this season and logged his third game of the season with at least one rushing and one receiving touchdown. Walker and the Chiefs will take on the Falcons in Week 10.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: CeeDee Lamb goes for 195 yards, TD in Week 9
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb caught 10 of his 16 targets for 195 yards and a touchdown in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
items.impact: Lamb lost a fumble early in the fourth quarter after making a spectacular catch for a 48-yard gain, the only blemish in an otherwise exceptional performance. The veteran wideout continues to post big numbers for the Cowboys, catching 70 balls for 904 yards and seven touchdowns through nine games. He will be a locked-in WR1 in Week 10 vs. the 49ers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II tosses two touchdowns in Week 9 win
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II completed 23-of-31 pass attempts for 242 yards and two touchdowns in a 35-12 win over the Jets. He rushed for eight yards on two carries.
items.impact: Mahomes connected with Kenneth Walker  for both of his touchdown passes in the win. Mahomes was hit hard on his throwing arm during the game and is currently dealing with an elbow injury. The Chiefs will likely have him undergo testing, but it is worth noting that Mahomes was well enough to finish out the game.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Tyler Goodson sees 12 carries in Week 9
items.desc: Tyler Goodson carried the ball 12 times for 77 yards and failed to catch his lone target in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
items.impact: Goodson set a season-high in carries and rushing yards in the close win over Indy. After playing sparingly in the early portions of the season, the veteran running back has started to carve out a bit of a role behind workhorse Javonte Williams of late, with 29 carries over his past three games. He sets up as a solid handcuff option in fantasy heading into Week 10 vs. the 49ers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jets D/ST allows 35 points in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Jets D/ST allowed 228 passing yards, 163 rushing yards, and 35 points in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: The Jets' defense tallied two sacks and two fumble recoveries in the loss. The Jets' defense will have another tough matchup in Week 10 against Josh Allen and the Bills.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Javonte Williams finds the end zone in Week 9
items.desc: Javonte Williams carried the ball 20 times for 101 yards and a touchdown while adding four catches for 23 yards on five targets in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
items.impact: Williams notched his second 100-yard rushing game of the season in the close win over Indy. The veteran running back has been a very reliable fantasy option this season, posting 10 all-purpose touchdowns through nine games. An every-week RB1 in fantasy, Williams will take on the 49ers in Week 10.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jason Sanders makes four field goals in Week 9
items.desc: Jason Sanders connected on 4-of-5 field goal attempts in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Sanders made field goals from 23, 48, 49, and 54 yards out to account for all of the Jets' scoring Sunday. His lone miss came on a 53-yard attempt late in the second quarter. Sanders and the Jets will look to bounce back against Buffalo in Week 10.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Dak Prescott throws two TDs in Week 9 win
items.desc: Dak Prescott completed 21 of 34 passes for 335 yards and two touchdowns in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
items.impact: Prescott turned in a solid game, tying a season-high with his 335 passing yards. One of Prescott's touchdown passes went to CeeDee Lamb while the other went to Jake Ferguson. Prescott has now thrown 16 touchdowns and five interceptions through nine games. He will be a mid-range QB1 in Week 10 vs. the 49ers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq logs four receptions in Week 9
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq caught 4-of-4 targets for 49 yards in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Sadiq outpaced fellow tight end Mason Taylor in all receiving categories Sunday. Both continue to split time weekly and have limited each other's fantasy value.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mason Taylor hauls in one pass in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Mason Taylor caught 1-of-2 targets for 11 yards in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Taylor saw Kenyon Sadiq outpace him in targets, receiving yards, and receptions in the loss Sunday. Both Taylor and Sadiq continue to split time in the Jets' offense, capping both of their fantasy values.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. hauls in eight passes in Week 9
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 8-of-11 targets for 58 yards in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Cooper led the Jets' pass catchers in targets, receptions, and receiving yards in the loss. This was a much needed bounce back performance after the rookie failed to record a target against the Raiders a week ago. Cooper and the Jets will take on the Bills in Week 10.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Adonai Mitchell held without a catch in Week 9
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell did not record a reception on seven targets in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Mitchell was second on the team in targets Sunday, but was the only pass catcher to not record a reception. This was a very disappointing result considering Mitchell had an excellent performance against Las Vegas last week. Mitchell and the Jets will look to bounce back against the Bills in Week 10.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Braelon Allen sees 10 touches in Week 9
items.desc: Braelon Allen rushed for 33 yards on eight carries in the Jets' 35-12 loss to the Chiefs. He caught both of his targets for 21 yards.
items.impact: Allen saw the return of Breece Hall to the lineup for the first time since Week 3. Allen has three 100 yard performances with Hall sidelined with a quad injury, but immediately saw his usage take a dip with Hall's return. Allen will likely remain the backup to Hall heading into a Week 10 matchup with Buffalo.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Breece Hall leads Jets' backfield in Week 9
items.desc: Breece Hall rushed for 61 yards on 15 carries in a 35-12 loss to the Jets. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 26 yards.
items.impact: Hall made his return from a quad injury that has kept him out of action since Week 3. Braelon Allen returned to the backup role, seeing eight rushing attempts to Hall's 15. Hall and the Jets will take on the Bills in Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Josh Jacobs (hand) questionable to return Sunday
items.desc: Josh Jacobs (hand) is questionable to return for the Green Bay Packers Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Jacobs suffered the hand injury late in the first quarter, rushing four times for five yards prior to exiting. Pierre Strong Jr. will take over in the backfield against the Patriots.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Geno Smith held in check in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Geno Smith completed 18-of-32 pass attempts for 165 yards in a 35-12 loss to the Jets. He added eight rushing yards on one carry.
items.impact: Smith and the Jets' offense failed to get anything consistent going, stalling out and having to settle for field goals in their scoring chances. This did break a streak of seven straight games with at least one passing touchdown for the veteran. Smith and the Jets will take on the Bills in Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kevin Coleman Jr. sees one touch in Week 9
items.desc: Kevin Coleman Jr. rushed once for 16 yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9.
items.impact: Coleman Jr. has struggled to make an impact on offense, finishing with less than 35 offensive yards in seven of eight contests. The wideout cannot be trusted in any format, with a Week 10 contest against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kaytron Allen sees two touches in Week 9
items.desc: Kaytron Allen rushed once for a loss of one yard while also catching his only target for 46 yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9.
items.impact: Allen has been an afterthought in the Miami offense when active, recording three or less touches in each of his five contests. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats until further notice ahead of a Week 10 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Carlos Washington Jr. catches pass in Week 9
items.desc: Carlos Washington Jr. caught his only target for eight yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9.
items.impact: Washington Jr. has been nonexistent on offense to this point in the seeing, logging his first touch in his two contests in Sunday's loss. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 10 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Will Kacmarek catches pass in Week 9
items.desc: Will Kacmarek caught one of his two targets for six yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9.
items.impact: Kacmarek has seen minimal involvement in the Miami offense to this point, logging one reception or less in each of his five games. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 10 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dolphins D/ST steady in Week 9
items.desc: The Dolphins D/ST registered three sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception) in a 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9.
items.impact: The defense did its part to keep an inept Miami offense in contention, holding the explosive Detroit offense to just 270 offensive yards and one touchdown in the loss. The unit will look for another solid performance against an inconsistent Indianapolis Colts offense in Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Zane Gonzalez misses field goal in Week 9
items.desc: Zane Gonzalez converted 3-of-4 field goal attempts to finish with nine points in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9.
items.impact: Gonzalez has battled consistency issues of late, missing one field goal attempt in each of his last two contests. The kicker will look to get back on track against the Indianapolis Colts in Week 10.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: J.J. McCarthy (hip) questionable to return
items.desc: Giants QB J.J. McCarthy (hip) is questionable to return against the Eagles.
items.impact: McCarthy went into the locker room after taking a hard hit on a rushing attempt. Jameis Winston will likely quarterback the Giants the rest of the way.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) active for Week 9
items.desc: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) is active for Week 9 for the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Robinson will take the field after being activated from injured reserve earlier in the week, immediately sliding into a starting wide receiver slot for an injury-riddled pass-catching group for head coach Kyle Shanahan against the Raiders.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Falcons D/ST allows 34 points in Week 9 loss
items.desc: The Falcons D/ST allowed 271 passing yards, 123 rushing yards, and 34 points in a loss to the Bengals.
items.impact: The Falcons' defense tallied two sacks, but failed to force a turnover in the loss Sunday. They will face a tough matchup in Week 10 as they take on the Chiefs.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Nick Folk misses another kick in Week 9
items.desc: Nick Folk connected on 1-of-2 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts in a 34-17 loss to the Benglas.
items.impact: Folk missed another field goal attempt Sunday, marking his fifth missed field goal this season. Folk will look to bounce back against Kansas City in Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) active for Week 9
items.desc: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) is active for Week 9 for the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Bosa is good to go after progressing throughout the week without suffering any setbacks, boosting a San Francisco defensive front against the Raiders for head coach Kyle Shanahan Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Charlie Woerner finds the end zone in Week 9
items.desc: Charlie Woerner caught his lone target for a one-yard touchdown in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
items.impact: Woerner caught the lone passing touchdown for the Falcons Sunday. Despite finding the end zone, fantasy managers can leave Woerner off their radar for now.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauls in three passes in Week 9
items.desc: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught 3-of-5 targets for 23 yards in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
items.impact: Pitts has seen a steady volume of targets, logging at least five in five straight games.  Despite that, Pitts has not eclipsed more than 23 yards in any of his last three games. Pitts andn the Falcons will take on the Chiefs in Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Mack Hollins (calf) active for Week 9
items.desc: Mack Hollins (calf) is active for Week 9 for the New England Patriots according to Evan Lazar.
items.impact: Hollins will take the field after being activated from injured reserve earlier in the week, boosting a New England wideout group that will be missing No. 1 option A.J. Brown against the Packers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jahan Dotson hauls in two passes in Week 9
items.desc: Jahan Dotson caught 2-of-2 targets for 16 yards in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
items.impact: Dotson logged the second most receptions by a Falcons' wide receiver in the game. Fantasy manages can leave Dotson off their roster heading into Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Hunter Henry (foot) active for Week 9
items.desc: Hunter Henry (foot) is active for Week 9 for the New England Patriots according to Evan Lazar.
items.impact: Henry is good to go after not suffering any issues during pregame testing, offering quarterback Drake Maye a stable pass-catching option against the Packers Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Drake London hauls in five passes in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Drake London caught all five of his targets for 68 yards in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
items.impact: London lead the Falcons in receiving yards in the loss Sunday. London has been held in check over the last two weeks, posting just 76 receiving yards on six receptions. London and the Falcons will look to bounce back against the Chiefs in Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Zaire Franklin (shin) inactive for Week 9
items.desc: Zaire Franklin (shin) is inactive for Week 9 for the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: Franklin will be sidelined after struggling to reach the practice field throughout the week, leaving the Green Bay defense without a key playmaker against the Patriots Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Khalil Herbert logs three touches in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Khalil Herbert rushed for seven yards on one carry in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals. He caught 2-of-3 targets for two yards.
items.impact: Herbert continues to serve as the backup running back with Brian Robinson out injured. Herbert has not seen enough playing time to be rostered by fantasy managers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: MarShawn Lloyd (knee) inactive for Week 9
items.desc: MarShawn Lloyd (knee) is inactive for Week 9 for the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: Lloyd will not suit up after being unable to clear through pregame tests, with Josh Jacobs to handle the majority of the backfield work anyways against the Patriots Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Bijan Robinson eclipses 100 rushing yards in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Bijan Robinson rushed for 100 yards and a touchdown on 19 carries in a 34-17 loss to the Flacons. He caught 6-of-7 targets for 47 yards.
items.impact: Robinson dominated the backfield touches for the Falcons and was able to account for 147 total yards in the loss. Robinson will look to continue his strong season in Week 10 against Kansas City.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. quiet in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. completed 20-of-31 passes for 162 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals. He also added 50 rushing yards on three carries.
items.impact: Penix connected with Charlie Woerner on his lone touchdown pass of the day. This was a much better performance than his four interception clunker in Week 8. Penix and the Falcons will take on the Chiefs in Week 10.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Bengals D/ST allows 17 points in Week 10 win
items.desc: The Bengals D/ST allowed 162 passing yards, 157 rushing yards, and 17 points in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: The Bengals' defense tallied one interception, but did not record a sack. The Bengals' defense was able to keep the Falcons' passing attack in check and will look to pick up their seventh win of the season in Week 10 against the Steelers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Evan McPherson perfect in Week 9 win
items.desc: Evan McPherson connected on both of his field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: McPherson made field goals from 43 and 57 yards out to help pace the Bengals to their sixth win of the season. McPherson continues to have an excellent season and will look to continue that against the Steelers in Week 10.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) ruled out for remainder of Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Denver's game against the Panthers on Sunday.
items.impact: Waddle was hit hard while trying to make a leaping grab, and eventually found his way to the medical tent and locker room to be examined for a concussion. Tough break for the talented receiver.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mike Gesicki hauls in two passes in Week 9
items.desc: Mike Gesicki caught both of his targets for 11 yards in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Gesicki had a streak of five straight games with a touchdown snapped Sunday. The veteran tight end had not logged a lot of receptions, but had provided fantasy managers with plenty of trips to the end zone. Gesicki and the Bengals will take on the Steelers in Week 10.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Dohnte Meyers hauls in two passes in Week 9 win
items.desc: Dohnte Meyers caught 2-of-3 targets for 47 yards in a 34-17 win over the Falcons. He rushed for 16 yards on one carry.
items.impact: Meyers continues to operate as the third wide receiver in the offense, but has not seen more than three targets since Week 4. Fantasy managers can leave the rookie out of starting lineups heading into Week 10.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tee Higgins hits pay dirt twice in Week 9 win
items.desc: Tee Higgins caught 5-of-6 targets for 32 yards and two touchdowns in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Higgins did not see a ton of targets Sunday, but made the most of his opportunities by hauling in two touchdowns. Higgins has found the end zone in three straight games, including back-to-back multi-touchdown performances. Higgins and the Bengals will look to continue that momentum against the Steelers in Week 10.
